name: Laplacian-Based Deformation for Gaussian Splatting
aliases: Proxy-Free Gaussian Splats Deformation with Splat-Based Surface Estimation
definition: A proxy-free Laplacian-based deformation framework for Gaussian splats that constructs a surface-aware splat graph based on kernel intersections to enable high-quality, large-scale deformation without external proxies.
summary: SpLap is a proxy-free Gaussian Splatting deformation framework that uses kernel intersections to build a surface-aware graph for robust, mesh-free geometric editing.
